caption: The drawing depicts two wooden dolls standing side by side against a plain, light-beige background. The doll on the left represents a female figure with carved, light-colored hair styled in side ringlets, and is dressed in a blue patterned, long-sleeved dress with white lace trim at the collar and sleeve ends, cream-colored pantaloons with lace at the hem, and black boots. The doll on the right represents a male figure with short, light-colored carved hair, wearing a dark blue, buttoned jacket with matching trousers, a white shirt underneath, and black shoes with vertical striping. Both dolls have simplified facial features and hands, and are positioned facing slightly towards each other. The artist's signature, "Eugene Croe," appears near the bottom right of the image.
title: Dolls
